title: Commission
body: Portraits and figurative works can be commissioned in charcoal, oil or mixed media, worked from your photographs or from sittings.
Send a short note with what you have in mind, the size you would like and any photographs, and Ed will reply with timings and a price.

steps.d: Email a short note with what you have in mind: who or what, the size you would like, and any photographs.
Ed replies with a medium, a size and a price. Charcoal, oil or mixed media, worked from your photographs or from sittings.
Progress photographs along the way, then the finished work delivered or collected, framed if you would like.
